words.supra: A Georgian feast, a shared table with toasts.
words.tamada: The toastmaster who leads a supra and honors those who came before.
words.qvevri: A clay vessel buried in the ground for making wine.
words.tonir: A clay bread oven; also spelled tone in Georgia.
words.minankari: Georgian cloisonné enamel, a craft of glass and metal.
words.iavnana: A Georgian lullaby sung to soothe and heal children.
words.devi: A giant of Georgian folk tales, plural devis.
words.shoti: Georgian bread baked on the wall of a clay oven.
